name: Sound Alert Entry Out
summary: This EA is a sound alert notification tool that monitors for trade entry and exit events, playing audio alerts when positions are opened or closed. It does not execute any trades itself but serves as an auditory monitoring utility for traders who need real-time notification of order activity.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个声音提醒工具，用于监控交易入场和出场事件，在持仓开仓或平仓时播放音频提醒。它本身不执行任何交易，而是为需要实时通知订单活动的交易者提供听觉监控工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于纯工具类程序，不包含任何交易策略逻辑。它通过监控账户持仓变化来检测新的入场和出场事件，当检测到新开仓或平仓时触发声音提醒。没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑，因为它不执行交易操作。其核心功能是持续轮询或监听订单状态变化，对比前后tick的持仓数量或订单列表差异来判断是否有新的交易活动。这种方式为交易者提供了不必持续盯盘的便利，尤其适合同时运行多个EA或管理多个品种的交易者。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility program that contains no trading strategy logic whatsoever. It monitors account position changes to detect new entry and exit events, triggering sound alerts when new openings or closings are detected. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic since it does not execute trades. Its core function is to continuously poll or listen for order state changes, comparing position counts or order lists across ticks to determine if new trading activity has occurred. This approach provides convenience for traders who do not need to constantly watch the screen, especially suited for those running multiple EAs or managing multiple instruments simultaneously.

pros: 提供实时声音提醒，交易者无需持续盯盘
入场和出场提醒可独立控制，灵活性高
轻量级工具，不干扰其他EA的交易逻辑
pros_en: Provides real-time sound alerts so traders do not need to constantly monitor the screen
Entry and exit alerts can be independently controlled for high flexibility
Lightweight utility that does not interfere with other EAs' trading logic
cons: 不执行任何交易，仅作为通知工具使用
依赖声音文件存在且格式正确，否则提醒失效
缺乏可视化界面或推送通知等更现代的提醒方式
cons_en: Does not execute any trades, serves only as a notification tool
Depends on sound files existing and being in the correct format, otherwise alerts fail
Lacks more modern notification methods such as visual interface or push notifications
improvements: 增加移动端推送通知功能（如发送至手机MT5应用）
添加邮件通知或Telegram机器人集成选项
improvements_en: Add mobile push notification functionality (e.g., sending alerts to the MT5 mobile app)
Add email notification or Telegram bot integration options

risk_points: 该EA不执行交易操作，无资金风险
若声音文件缺失可能导致提醒失效，但不影响交易账户安全
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute trading operations, posing no financial risk
Missing sound files may cause alert failure, but do not affect trading account safety
